scenes.say: Do street lights look stretched or streaky at night? It may be astigmatism.

scenes.en: Normal cornea: round like a football. Astigmatism: curved more one way, like a rugby ball.
scenes.ta: கார்னியா வட்டமாக இல்லாமல் முட்டை வடிவில் இருக்கும்
scenes.say: The clear front window of your eye, the cornea, is normally round like a football. With astigmatism, it is curved more in one direction, like a rugby ball.

scenes.en: Light focuses at two points instead of one. Near and far can both blur.
scenes.ta: ஒளி ஒரே இடத்தில் குவியாது, அதனால் மங்கல்
scenes.say: So light does not focus at one single point. Things can look blurry or stretched, both near and far.

scenes.en: Squinting, eye strain, headaches, glare at night
scenes.say: Common signs are squinting, tired eyes after screen work, headaches, and glare at night.

scenes.en: Astigmatism is very common. Many people have a little, often with short or long sight.
scenes.ta: இது மிகவும் சாதாரணம். பலருக்கு கொஞ்சம் இருக்கும்
scenes.say: Did you know? Astigmatism is very common. Many people have a little, and it often comes with short sight or long sight. It is not a disease.

scenes.en: Get an eye test. A 'cylinder' power in glasses corrects it. Toric contact lenses help too.
scenes.ta: கண் பரிசோதனை செய்யுங்கள். சரியான கண்ணாடி போதும்
scenes.say: Get a full eye test. A special power called cylinder in your glasses corrects it. Toric contact lenses can help too. If your power keeps changing quickly, or vision drops suddenly, see an eye specialist.
Clear, sharp vision can be one eye test away. Book yours today.
